notes.title: 0.9.8.3 “LINGUA FRANCA" LOCALIZATON-PREPARATORY UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hope 2017 is off to a good start for you all. We're getting ready for international release, thus a decent number of translations are being prepared for implementation courtesy of today's "Lingua Franca" update. Soon, air-combat action gamers in Germany, France, Poland, Spain, China, Japan, Mexico, Taiwan, Russia, Brazil, and more countries, can take to the skies in their native language!

(On a side note, the Lingua Franca moniker was chosen as a name for the final English update as the term fittingly means "a language or dialect used to make communication possible between people who do not share a native language"). 

[list]
[*][b]Strings[/b]: Finalized English-language strings in preparation for translation and the upcoming multi-lingual/international release.

[*][b]Performance[/b]: 3D-renderer now optimized for low-end PCs, circa +30% more efficient occlusion culling, resulting in lower stress on bandwidth.

[*][b]UX[/b]: New default. Players can now toggle the free-roaming Panoramic Camera by holding Left ALT and moving the mouse to look around (if playing on MOUSE+KEYBOARD, for example).

[*][b]GUI[/b]: Updated text-system for multi-player lobby and console/log output strings.

[*][b]Aircraft[/b]: Implemented cockpits for amphibious fighter planes A6M2-N "Rufe" and SC-1 "Seahawk".

[*][b]Audio/Music[/b]: Updated multiplayer lobby, mission result, and main theme tracks.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.9.8.1 “TOUCHDOWN" UPDATE — WATCH THE VIDEO FOR DETAILS
notes.notes:
It's a good Wednesday! The "Touchdown" Steam Update is live. In short; the single player campaign has been completed and full voice over has been implemented to all 12 missions, new cockpits added, an option is there to allow aspiring multiplayer pilots restrict/set the control-style for online matches, and, we've improved rendering once again!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=taArg7uji2w
[list]
[*][b]Single player campaign mode.[/b] Completed, full with 12 voiced missions!

[*][b]Rendering improved once again.[/b] Now aircraft, landscape and weather look richer and more vividly lit, especially if you’re running the game on the CINEMATIC graphics setting.
 
[*][b]A new multiplayer setting lets hosts restrict control-style for matches.[/b] If you want to go head to head in an online game with players flying EXCLUSIVELY with the more advanced PITCH & ROLL setting, or with ARCADE only, grab this update, get airborne and knock yourself out!
 
[*][b]Match modes have been renamed for clarification.[/b] For example, the MASTER OF THE SKIES multiplayer mode is now called DOGFIGHT VERSUS, and we’ve got ROCKET MATCH VERSUS and TEAM ROCKET MATCH, and so on.

[*][b]Cockpits added for Japanese A6M2 Zero and the P-51D Mustang.[/b]
[/list]

And hey, remember -- keep your pistol holstered at all times!

Ace Maddox

notes.title: 0.9.8.0 “ROCKET MATCH/GOBI" UPDATE — WATCH THE NARRATED YOUTUBE VIDEO FOR DETAILS
notes.notes:
Happy to let you all know the latest FTSOC Steam update has finally gone live! New features include ROCKET MATCH, a fresh multiplayer mode that lets 2-16 players go head-to-head over the Chinese-Mongolian Gobi desert in a variety of fighter-jets, including the American P-80A "Shooting Star" and the Japanese Ki-201 "Fire Dragon" (Me-262a). 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EhqX2kbmpR0
[list]
[*][b]ROCKET MATCH multiplayer mode.[/b] This new mode lets 2-16 players fly head-to-head in rocket-equipped fighter planes. Aircraft include the P-80A "Shooting Star", the P-38L Lightning, the Ki-201 "Fire Dragon", the Mizuno II "Divine Dragon", the I-16 Polikarpov and the P-51D Mustang.
 
[*][b]Campaign VO.[/b] Recorded and implemented complete American & British voice over dialogue for East of Martaban campaign mission.
 
[*][b]New fighter-jets (with cockpits).[/b] Added the USAAF P-80A "Shooting Star" with cockpit and four skins. Japanese Ki-201 "Fire Dragon" with cockpit (and four skins) also implemented. Finally, Japan's unusual/experimental Mizuno Shinryu II "Divine Dragon" made available too, also with four skins.
 
[*][b]Retrofitted Vildebeest cockpit.[/b] The RAF bi-plane torpedo fighter Vickers Vildebeest Mk. III finally has a (semi-open) cockpit view.
 
[*][b]Field of View.[/b] Added and adjusted FoV (Field of View) for gameplay and cockpit cameras for improved visibility. Use (default) C / V keys to cycle back and forth to set/try the improved WIDE cameras.
 
[*][b]New BRIGHTNESS option.[/b] Not entirely unlike GAMMA control, the new brightness option lets you adjust screen visibility (via DISPLAY SETTINGS).
 
[*][b]New ENEMY CROSSHAIR option.[/b] Let's you adjust the size of the red sub-crosshair to improve enemy target visibility (via HUD settings).
[/list]

Many thanks for your continued support, beloved Early Access customers!

And hey -- don't forget to pull out your landing gear on your way down.

Ace Maddox

notes.title: 0.9.7.0 “COCKPIT/CAMPAIGN" UPDATE — VIEW THE NARRATED YOUTUBE VIDEO FOR DETAILS!
notes.notes:
It’s been quite some time since you’ve heard from us gamedev-mechanics here at Ace Maddox, so hopefully today’s additions will make you all pleased. Have a look at the spoken/narrated YouTube video below for the details.

YouTube Video URL: https://youtu.be/Zy4WPjSZ3Tc
Update History/Changelog:

[*][b]Four new cockpits and "wide" interior camera added.[/b] Hop inside the P-40E, Buffalo Mk. I, Lysander Mk. II or the Japanese Ki-43 fighter! If you're playing on keyboard and/or mouse, just press the V key to check out the newly added cockpit "wide" camera. And, there's also a refurbished bomb-targeting system for when you're seated in cockpit mode.
 
[*][b]Voice actors exhausted as Campaign nears competion.[/b] Development of FTSOC's historical single player campaign is almost complete. We've updated some of the older voices, while a multitude of actors have been working around the clock to record the remainder of the Campaign mission's screenplay in proper. We suggest you give the Campaign a full playthrough, so you can hear for yourselves. 
 
[*][b]Controller vibration.[/b] For those of you who prefer to play/fly with a gamepad, there's now controller rumble for stronger "immersion". 
 
[*][b]Improved rendering.[/b] Shadows and reflections look sharper and are more stable now, this specially noticeable when you're seated inside. 
 
[*][b]Toggle HUD elements on the fly.[/b] Press the H key while flying to control displaymode of the various HUD elements (handy feature when recording video or FRAPSing stills).
 
[*][b]Ship models.[/b] We've updated most of the game's warship models, plus added a typical Southeast Asian wooden cargo ship, namely the Malayan Bedar (which, incidentally, does not look entirely unrelated to the Chinese junk).
 
[*][b]More Challenges.[/b] We've added two new mini-missions in the form of challenges, so go ahead and take that dusty old Vildebeest for a bit of tinfish-safari off the Akyab coast in the new TORPEDOGS challenge, or try out the bombs and machine guns of the Allied P-43A fighter in GROUND ATTACK.
 
[*][b]Added captured Japanese fighter.[/b] We've implemented a captured P-40E fighter, bombs included, to spice up multiplayer cockpit-dogfighting a little.

Enjoy the spectacle,

Ace Maddox

notes.title: 0.9.5.8 “COCKPIT/CONTENDER" UPDATE — ADDED COCKPIT SUPPORT, NEW FIGHTERS, MULTIPLAYER IMPROVEMENTS
notes.notes:
Nothing quite shocks the senses like the chilly winds and intense air-battles of 1940s southeast Asia. Today’s summery FTSOC Steam update not only improves multiplayer features, but also retrofits cockpit view/support, starting with a functional inside rendition of the RAF's tropical Spitfire Mk. V. Furthermore, a pair of new fighters have been made available namely the Allied P-47D “Thunderbolt” and the Japanese Ki-44 Shoki "Toji", each with a decent selection of skins and over-the-radio voice shouts in American, Chinese, Russian and Japanese languages.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T7evdu_0olw

[*] [b]Added support for cockpit view.[/b] Just getting started on fighter interiors. Buckle up in the Spitfire Mk. V fighter in the Multiplayer, Dogfight or Free Flight modes (press "V" to cycle cameras/cockpit).

[*] [b]Online features improved.[/b] Collapsed multiplayer JOIN/HOST menus for better overview and accessibility, improved lobby/match views, added Steam invites (via lobby and pause screens), Leaderboards readily accessible, Steam profile avatars used for both multiplayer games and match stats, adjusted formatting/layout to make native chat more pleasant (use RETURN/ENTER to toggle chat).

[*] [b]Multiplayer modes.[/b] Flying below 200 ft partially hides you allowing for interesting escapes and sudden "jumps" on opponents. Player health for all multiplayer modes now displayed in the match stats/overview.

[*] [b]Visuals.[/b] Improved scene rendering for increased shadow and tree stability on (resulting in a less distractive landscape view).

[*] [b]Just for fun.[/b] Implemented real-time "documentary" color modes; sepia, black & white and vintage filters (available via the DISPLAY SETTINGS menu).

[*] [b]Two new fighter aircraft.[/b] P-47D “Thunderbolt” and Ki-44 Shōki “Toji” fighters with multiple skins and voice shouts.


Enjoy your weekend,

Ace Maddox

notes.title: 0.9.5.1 “DOGFIGHT DAZE" UPDATE — TWO NEW AIRCRAFT; P-43A AND BF 109E, DOGFIGHT AI IMPROVED, MULTIPLE FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS
notes.notes:
Don’t look back — someone might be gaining on you!

Today’s update adds improved dogfight AI and two new fighters, the Allied P-43A-1 “Lancer” (with Chinese ROCAF and USAAF skins) and, perhaps unexpectedly, a Japanese Messerschmitt! Germany supplied Japan with a number of evaluation Bf 109Es for comparison trials by the Japanese Army Air Force. The Allies, expecting to encounter those Bf 109Es in combat, assigned code name “Mike” to the Messerschmitts.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B9MYMy2G8eQ

Here’s the rundown;

[list]
[*]Increased cool-down duration of arcade maneuvers to make them less spammy [in multiplayer and elsewhere].

[*]Improved dogfight AI; AVENGING ACE and SURVIVAL modes now more challenging (not necessarily more difficult).

[*]Better display support, the game now runs on three monitors with HUD elements in the center screen.

[*]Began implementing skillshot/reward badge effects in dogfight modes, coming to multiplayer soon (in development, apologies for the rough polish).

[*]Added a setting to toggle the hold (auto-camera) of OBSERVE TARGET function (that’s the F key on default setting M+K or K).

[*]Invert X-Axis for the panoramic camera view now possible.

[*]Fixed numerous crashes in the “EAST OF MARTABAN" campaign mission.

[*]P-43A-1 “Lancer” and Bf 109 “Mike” fighters with multiple skins implemented.

[*]Various minor GUI enhancements.
[/list]

Until next time, lower away!

Ace Maddox

[*] New aircraft: Japanese [b]Ki-84-Ic Hayate "Frank"[/b]  which in the opinion of many was the top fighter of Imperial Japan, plus ROCAF flew them too (captured) after the end of WW2, hence the Chinese skin.

notes.title: 0.9.2 "ROCKET LIGHTNING" UPDATE; P-38L ETC AVAILABLE
notes.notes:
Rockets by night, for lightning we fight!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5aec5PcGTWM

Took awhile to get this update out since we've kept more than a little busy re-hauling many of the game's back-end systems including the HUD and GUI for improved icon-supported hint and instructional messages, rocket-capable weapons support (P-38L equipped with HVAR rockets via the new CHALLENGE MODE), plus lots of other improvements not the least for input/controls so PITCH/ROLL (and YAW) should be better balanced for flightsticks and gamepads.

All in all, we're steadily approaching the final version. Here's the rundown for today’s update:

[list]
[*] Improved flightstick support. For example, Saitek's "dual device" X-55 Rhino H.O.T.A.S. system is now fully configurable.

[*] “HVAR” rocket weapons system implemented via P-38L Lightning, try the new ROCKET LIGHTNING Single Player Challenge for some explosive fun (P-38L with rockets also available in FREE FLIGHT/DOGFIGHT modes).

[*] Added “city light” rendering feature; take-off for a test-flight over Akyab or Rangoon in the middle of the night to sample a myriad of shiny, digital light-bulbs.

[*] HUD/GUI updated so controls and hint messages are now more visual, dynamic icons for improved gamepad, keyboard and flight stick control instructions.

[*] Adjusted the Campaign mode’s difficulty so that it (should) take more skill and less luck to complete missions (note: work in progress).

[*] New aircraft: C-46A “Commando” replaces the DC-2 transport for FREE FLIGHT and “OVER THE HUMP” Campaign mission.

[*] New aircraft: Upgraded the Hurricane Mk. II fighter so it looks a little sleeker, now comes with five selectable skins — including the famous England-China “Nightflyer”!

[*] New aircraft: P-38L Lightning fighter aircraft added with HVAR weapons system for firing rockets. Four skins available including a ROCAF (Nationalist China) camouflage.
[/list]

We’re working on a new [b]multiplayer rocket mode[/b] too, once we have a few more rocket-bearing aircraft implemented, such as the Mizuno Shinryū “Divine Dragon” and quite possibly also a Japanese Me-262  -- Germany actually sold five of them to Japan for evaluation -- you’ll be the first to know!

Until next time,

Ace Maddox

notes.title: 0.9.1 "ICARUS" PRELIMINARY CONTROLS UPDATE
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that FTSOC's control-system has been overhauled and upgraded! Meet the ICARUS patch. Many new options, including sim-style PITCH, ROLL and YAW controls have been implemented. In addition, we've added a few more features such horizontal and vertical "auto-stabilizators" to further improve the original ARCADE flying style. A free-roaming "Panoramic Camera" feature has also been implemented, so if you play on mouse you can simply hold MMB to look around (and if you're playing on KEYBOARD, just move the mouse to activate the Panoramic Camera).

Please note that ICARUS may still have some issues, mainly with Saitek flightsticks on Windows 10. We're working on it though, and are planning to release the full controls update shortly.

Here's the shortlist:
[list]
[*] Implemented optional PITCH/ROLL and rudder (YAW) controls.
[*] Added "Panoramic Camera" feature that lets players look around freely.
[*] Rebuilt the SETTINGS/SETUP CONTROLS GUI for better overview and improved navigation.
[*] New gameplay cameras. Press "V" to toggle NORMAL/FAR/NEAR.
[*] Game Balancing: Made several adjustments to difficulty and AI.
[/list]

Back to work, and oh, we've got Trading Cards nearly done too, they should release in less than a week.

As Japan's mysterious elite unit, the 56th armored division of the "Red Dragons", attempted to advance towards China's wartime capital Chungking via the Burma Road and over the Salween river, a flight of bomb-equipped P-40Es led by none else than Tex Hill, managed to force-halt the enemy on the river bank by carrying out highly successful precision bombing (which was not even a concept back then!).

notes.title: 0.8.7 "MINGALADON" UPDATE
notes.notes:
After a short hiatus, we’re more than a little happy to introduce a new, historical campaign mission entitled [b]BACK TO MINGALADON![/b]

Took us a few weeks extra to get this update done and dusted, reason being we decided to enhance our custom-built air-combat action 3D engine technology to allow for explosively [b]EPIC[/b] air-battles so get ready to engage [b]100+ SIMULTANEOUS ENEMY AIRCRAFT![/b]

February 25, 1942. Patrols have been maintained over Mingaladon all week, effectively cancelling any element of surprise the enemy may otherwise have obtained. Today’s reconnoitre sorties have already resulted in a big sweep of Japanese fighters being discouraged by a trio of P-40s and a flight of six Hurricanes.

[list]
[*]Revamped the chase-event to make it user-friendlier and more immersive with a new Sepia-effect, also updated the somewhat related spin maneuver (and camera) so players are less likely to lose sight of active enemy targets during dogfights.

[*]Enhanced our custom-built 3D engine to allow for epic air-war with [b]100+ SIMULTANEOUS AIRCRAFT[/b].

[*]Implemented the 9th campaign mission [b]BACK TO MINGALADON[/b] based on historical air-battles that took place on February 25th 1942 in southern Burma.

[*]Added support for ground-based rear-gunner FPS action.

[*]Lots of (minor) bug-fixes.
[/list]

[i]On a side note, Mingaladon was an important Allied airfield located just outside Rangoon (actually, it’s still there, look up [i]Yangon International Airport[/i] on Wikipedia if you’re interested) that was home to both the RAF and the Flying Tigers (American Volunteer Group) during the first half of the AVG’s existence.[/i]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oP34RoxPJao

notes.title: 0.8.6 "HIMALAYAS" UPDATE
notes.notes:
This update brings you the next campaign mission [b]OVER THE HUMP[/b], set in the snow-clad mountain tops of the Himalayas and based on the infamous airlift that replaced the "Burma road" supply route in the spring of 1942, after Allied resistance in the Far East had nearly collapsed.

American transports have begun carrying military supplies via the Hump; a dangerous supply route starting in Assam, India and ending in Kunming, China. USAAF cargo crews must navigate the difficult mountainous area in harsh weather almost blindly. In northern Burma, Lashio and Myitkyina have fallen into Japanese hands, allowing roving Japanese fighters to patrol the area!

[b]Get ready to fly as the AVG and RAF in a blizzard of dogfighting action that would chill even the whitest of walkers to the bone![/b]

[list]
[*]Added the [b]HIMALAYAS[/b] map, explore it in the [b]MULTIPLAYER[/b], [b]DOGFIGHT[/b] or [b]FREE FLIGHT[/b] modes.

[*]Finalised the [b]SNOW[/b] weather effect.

[*]Implemented the 8th campaign mission [b]OVER THE HUMP[/b], based on the infamous India-China airlift that went over the Himalayan mountain peaks.

[*]Various (minor) bug-fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: 8.0.5 "LUCKY DAY AKYAB" UPDATE
notes.notes:
The story behind Japanese fighter ace Katō and his unlikely nemesis, RAF gunner Sgt. McLuckie, is almost too good to be true! Check it out in new campaign mission [b]LUCKY DAY AKYAB[/b]. We've also gone to great lengths to add in [b]LOOP MANEUVERING[/b] so aspiring (and experienced) pilots can feel the thrill of 360 degree air-combat action -- fly straight on or upside down, pull back in full on that mouse, flight stick or gamepad and your plane will come around full circle!

Anything else? Yes! The [b]J2M RAIDEN[/b] Japanese fighter has been added and can be flown in the [b]MULTIPLAYER[/b], [b]DOGFIGHT[/b] and [b]FREE FLIGHT[/b] modes, whereas the new coastal map [b]AKYAB[/b] hopefully adds a bit of beauty to the selection of scenery.

Experience the unbelievable but true demise of Japanese fighter ace Lt Colonel Tateo Katō who was downed over the Bay of Bengal by lone and unescorted rear-gunner turned crack-shot Sgt "Jock" McLuckie under incredibly unfavourable circumstances. So, the new campaign mission [b]LUCKY DAY AKYAB[/b] let's you fly the Blenheim light-bomber over Akyab on the coast of Burma, in the capacity of both squadron leader and rear-gunner, under the markings of recently re-equipped No. 60 RAF Squadron.

[i]On a side note, Katō had considerable propaganda value, and the Japanese sponsored the 1944 war movie Colonel Tateo Katō's Flying Squadron glorifying his life story. Its special effects was created by none other than Godzilla and Ultraman creator Eiji Tsuburaya (just saying!).[/i]

[b]Expect plenty of bombing, gunner action, honorable defeat and a bit of a history lesson![/b]

[list]
[*]Added the Japanese [b]J2M RAIDEN[/b] fighter aircraft. Try it out in [b]MULTIPLAYER[/b] or in the [b]FREE FLIGHT[/b] or [b]DOGFIGHT[/b] modes!

[*]Implemented [b]LOOP MANEUVERING[/b] which lets you take your silver bird high up in the sky just to go upside insane on the way down.

[*]Added the 7th campaign mission, [b]LUCKY DAY AKYAB[/b], which takes place in clear day off the coast of Burma on the island of Akyab.

[*]Various (minor) bug-fixes.
[/list]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oP34RoxPJao

notes.notes:

[list]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oP34RoxPJao
[*]Two new maps playable in Multiplayer, Dogfight or Free Flight: [b]Indian Ocean[/b] and [b]Mandalay Area[/b] (that's in Burma!).
